item.title: Edit Variable
item.description: Edit Variable changes the content of a previously created variable. Parameters are: Variable: lists all variables; Value: entry for the new variable content.

item.title: External Code
item.description: External Code shows a panel for external code entry. You must have Flash properly set in order to use this interaction, otherwise your content will not be saved.

item.title: Restart Tracking Var
item.description: Restart Track Variable cleans up the file who tracks variables.
